description.value:
You make a ranged tech attack against a creature within range. On a hit, the target takes 4d8 ion damage. If the target has tech points, it must also succeed on an Intelligence saving throw or lose 5 tech points, as if it had expended a tech slot.

Cast with a tech slot of 4th level or higher, the ion damage increases by 1d8 and the tech points lost increase by 1 for each slot level above 3rd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 3
